results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested poster background, decorations, title and balloon, the black-and-gold fountain pen retains its identifying details but is visibly moved down/right and shortened in the composition. Instruction: the white product shot becomes a blue gradient poster with white clouds, stars, candy, a right-hand bear balloon and the correct colorful bold title. These meet the poster design requirements, but the source actually contains a pen rather than the stated bear balloon, and the result remains dominated by a large pen instead of the intended balloon-centered design; compliance is partial. Quality: coherent legible lettering, clean cartoon shapes, convincing pen texture and an orderly cheerful layout, with no noticeable generation defect.

Consistency: the backdrop, central brass support, black base, right pan and four right weights retain their appearance and positions; the original left weight remains. Instruction: an additional weight is visible on the left, but it is perched high above the original weight on an odd narrow connector rather than properly seated in the pan. A correctly supported second left weight is expected, so the main addition is only partly realized. Knowledge: the explanation requires two left weights and a leftward tilt. Two are depicted, but the beam and pans remain level and the added weight has implausible support; these are serious physical conflicts. Quality: lighting, brass texture and background are coherent, but the upper left weight and thin protruding connector form a conspicuously unnatural stacked structure.
